doubts: Q2, Q3, Q6, Q7, X4, Y5 (PPO2 part) and Y8 quotes are partly from the supplement (supplement pages 1, 3, 5, 6). Q6 and X4: the grid search is described for the PPO control only; POET's own values are not justified; the equal compute budget supports X4. Q7 and Y8: the only held-out-style evaluation is the appendix cross-environment matrix (agents tested on environments other than their paired one, though transfers may have trained them there); coded yes, borderline. Y3: one domain (bipedal obstacle courses), the 15 target environments are drawn from it. Y12: bootstrapped 95% CIs on a median count yes under the simple bootstrap rule.
